title: Optimal large language models to screen citations for systematic reviews

live_model.evidence: Refers to "our previous study" where GPT-4 Turbo was used; this paper's own comparison instead runs GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, and Llama 3.3 70B.

prompt.note: The current paper reuses a prompt originally built for GPT-4 Turbo in an earlier (cited) study, but does not re-run GPT-4 Turbo itself here.

claim.metric: none for GPT-4 Turbo in this paper (its results are reported in the earlier, cited study, not this one)

notes: GPT-4 Turbo is referenced three times, always as background to the authors' own earlier study; the current paper's four-model comparison (GPT-4o, Gemini 1.5 Pro, Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Llama 3.3 70B) does not include GPT-4 Turbo as a tested arm.
